items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: See, when we used to play some time, we used to play all mixed up bands... they wanted to play with him like that.

ctx.x: Trombone player. He got his son playing trumpet. He come home one night off his job, and he got hungry, and he got some fried, fried, hot potato, and he didn't eat any gestures. Raymond Brown, that's it, man. You remember him, eh? Yeah, I believe I do. Yeah, that was an ensemble. See, when we used to play some time, we used to play all mixed up bands. They'd send me, even send me, they'd live up there, you know, up in Coralton, in the same block. And they'd get a job, and they'd get punished, but they wanted to…
Yeah, the bass got... You want to turn it off on me?
